name: H100-scale copper TTV
notes: Coefficient fitted once at 510 W (4.4186e-8 W/um2K), frozen for 720 and 920 W. Local saturation references differ by power. The probe centre is 5 um below the surface; remove its conduction offset. Copper case, not GPU junction.

name: H200-scale plate boundary
notes: 700 W; 38 C inlet; frozen 40,800 W/m2K boundary over 1259.28 mm2. Contact-plane map, not source/junction. Active inlet is 311.15 K. This is an exact 11.15 K reference shift of the archived constant-property model, with no HTC refit. A 65 C upper limit is not a measured temperature.

name: Stratum-L cold plate
notes: 300 W GPU plus six 40 W logic and six 102 W memory blocks: 1152 W over 46.6 x 34.5 mm. Top h=2.78e-8 at 300 K, insulated bottom, 125 um cells. Compare the hottest logic or memory die with the 86 C PINN reference. The original transient and nonuniform inputs are unchanged in provenance/. The uniform engine truncates 46600/125 to 372 x-cells; the exact supplied grid is retained.

name: Stratum-S cold plate
notes: 100 um grid; explicit 2 mm copper base, 20 um TIM, hybrid bond and orthotropic Cu-TGV composite. Reference is the project matched Icepak comparison. Coolant 300 K and plate h=4.08e-8 are frozen.

name: Glass microchannel + Cu-TGV
source: Kim et al., ESTC 2026; author-input vehicle
notes: 16.252928 W on a 2.56 x 2.56 mm heater (248 W/cm2), 2.8 mm domain, water 25.46 mL/min at 295.15 K. 10 physical glass channels with copper TGVs. The 2RM pitch approximation rounds its effective channel count to 9; this finite-width approximation is part of the supplied case. HTC 50,000 W/m2K, 10 um interface, die source depth and effective TGV conductivity are modeling assumptions, not author-supplied or independently fitted values.

name: Cu-pillar pin-fin vehicle
source: Kim et al., ESTC 2026; direct-contact vehicle
notes: Corrected 1 mm active-region model and 111 um pitch variant. Use the die/source-plane maximum; RDL map is a separate observation plane. See active stack for flow and material assumptions.

name: Silicon interlayer microchannels
notes: The reported 86.51 C is the original 22 mL/min/layer input (archived output 359.656 K). Lid h=1.292e-8 is calibrated at a separate cold-plate baseline. Reference 0.3 g/s corresponds to about 18 mL/min; the selected flow is 22% higher and conditional on the flow convention/fit. The 18-22 mL/min inputs are included, and the 18 mL/min result is approximately 94.89 C. This row must not be described as a held-out test at nominal 18 mL/min.

name: HyFlexPIM Cu-pillar pin-fin
source: Ansys Icepak matched HyFlexPIM package (paper Table II)
notes: 140.7 W duty-weighted floorplan; 26.1 x 17.4 mm; pin-fin Darcy velocity 1e6 um/s. Pin-fin declaration precedes dimensions in native 3D-ICE grammar. Legacy absolute paths are removed. No source, geometry or boundary coefficient was fitted during reorganization.

name: HyFlexPIM microchannel + Cu-TGV
source: Ansys Icepak conjugate CFD anchor (paper Fig. 2a)
notes: 130 channels, 156.5 mL/min, 300 K inlet, h_eff=1.27e-8. Geometry, power and flow are frozen; circular Hausen and square-duct alternatives remain as controlled coefficient comparisons. Raw CFD wall-flux patches are not bundled; tools/calibrate.py accepts them for a new anchor.

name: Photonic PIC map
notes: Compare named PIC footprints in the 2.5D package. The reference 40 C is a field/colorbar bound rather than a matched measured scalar peak. Excluded from the eight-point percentage aggregate. The 3D package variant is included for a stacking trend check.
